variant_definitions.A0_full_hybrid_attention: Full model: semantic tokens + 32-dimensional feature-group embedding + 4-head self-attention + residual/LayerNorm + feed-forward block + mean pooling + classifier.
variant_definitions.A1_no_self_attention: Semantic tokens + 32-dimensional feature-group embedding + mean pooling + classifier; self-attention block removed.
variant_definitions.A2_no_semantic_tokenization: Original 21 standardized predictors treated as one vector with a dedicated 21-to-32 projection, LayerNorm, GELU, and matched classifier; semantic tokenization and attention removed.
variant_definitions.A3_single_head_attention: Same full architecture as A0, but self-attention uses one head instead of four.

a2_input_reconstruction: Original 21 standardized predictors reconstructed from non-padded positions of the four preprocessing tokens; no new scaling or partitioning.
